$schema_note: Hand-verified game knowledge, NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file. Two numberings the Mark 1 set (ForgePact #166) uses side by side: `keys` are item stat keys, what an item's stats map holds and what the Custom Forge writes; `dispatcher_ids` are gml_Script_ReturnSpecificStat's stat-id argument, each answered by one getter script. `set_lines` is how the game's tooltip draws a set bonus line. `status` is `measured` (observed live or in Item Truth's captures) or `static_reading` (read from the compiled code locally and paraphrased; AGENTS.md section Legal).

source.semantics: hero-siege-item-editor/hs_stat_semantics_s10.json, schemaVersion 1, generated 2026-09-02 (read from the main checkout, never edited)
source.item_truth: ForgePact Item Truth journals, 184 files, build pe-6aaa6779-0cad4fc8, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-21: each drawn pass's draw_text rows and DrawInventoryStatsNew calls (id, label, format, style, height), the labels confirmed against the semantics file (ForgePact #166, 2026-10-22)
source.dispatcher: the dispatcher's case map rss_cases.json beside the indexed ReturnSpecificStat decompile (2026-10-04, build 498d588550d8), a static reading kept on the researcher's machine only

numbering_note: Neither numbering here is hs_game_sdk.stats.StatId's: StatId is a different numbering (hub #546), so never look a key or a dispatcher id up through it.

20.name: Sockets
20.drawn: the `Sockets (N)` text row after the stat lines, no stat call

154.name: Defense
154.drawn: the header `Defense: N`, no stat call; N with Enhanced Defense (key 29) applied is inferred, not measured

294.name: Skill Movement Diminish decreased by
294.note: the reduction of the cast's movement slowdown, not a movement-speed stat; whether it feeds dispatcher id 199 is not established

dispatcher_note: Each getter's only direct caller is ReturnSpecificStat (a headless byte scan with a positive control, 2026-10-22, for StatMaxLife, StatDefense, StatArmor, StatAllResistances, StatFireResist, StatLifeReplenish, StatPhysicalDamageReduction, StatAllSkills and StatLifePerKill). Calls through the script table or a method value are invisible to that scan: not observed, not excluded.

set_line.words: a row reads the value then the label for style 8 (`+500 Defense`) and the label then the value for style 9 (`Replenish Life 25%`); a negative value is drawn signed (`-125% to All Resistances`)
